title: Gate controller retries GitHub 5xx and always completes the krn/gate check
body:
Outcome: a transient GitHub API error at the end of a Product gate build never leaves `krn/gate` in_progress forever; the controller retries 5xx with bounded backoff, and a terminal failure still completes the check (failure, summary `failed at stage <stage>: <cause>`) so deliver can rerun at once.
Evidence (PR #232, head de9f3dc, 2026-11-05): Jenkins ci/product/PR-232 #1 ran all stages in 787 s (17:06-17:19Z), then `ci.Controller.requireCurrentHead` (Controller.groovy:296 via ownedCi.groovy:229) got `HttpException: Service Unavailable` from `GHRepository.getPullRequest`; publishChecks logged "Failure check publication is unverified" and the check stayed in_progress 70+ min; deliver exited 74 "ci: bounded wait timed out". Diagnosis: .krn/runs/lead/t-vrbgwbk/gate-stuck.md.
This is ci-platform production code: deploying the fix needs the deployment owner's grant (batch with t-6997d21, t-33mv33n). Related: t-47enn80 (deliver timeout outcome).
Proof: a controller test where getPullRequest throws 503 twice then succeeds (passes) and always throws (check completed as failure with the stage named).

Also: `krn ci rerun` exits 75 'check run is still in_progress' when the Jenkins build already finished but the check was never completed; the lead had to POST the native job /build (201, new check 127442328242). rerun must read the Jenkins build state, not only the GitHub check status.

Lead trap: when `krn/gate` stays in_progress after the Jenkins build finished, `krn ci rerun` exits 75; POST the native `/job/ci/job/product/job/PR-<n>/build` through the lead tunnel instead (never re-push).
